description: This file defines the OrderSetService interface in the OpenMRS project, outlining methods for creating, retrieving, updating, retiring, unretiring, and deleting order sets and their attributes.

methods.name: setOrderSetDAO
methods.description: Sets the data access object for order sets to enable database operations.

methods.name: saveOrderSet
methods.description: Saves or updates an OrderSet in the database, applying retirement details if necessary.

methods.name: getOrderSets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all OrderSets, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OrderSet by its integer ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSet by its UUID.

methods.name: retireOrderSet
methods.description: Retires a provided OrderSet with a specified reason.

methods.name: getAllOrderSetAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all OrderSetAttributeTypes, including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its internal ID.

methods.name: retireOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Retires an OrderSetAttributeType with a specified reason.

methods.name: purseOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderSetAttributeType from the system.
